    - text: "ossia score supports multi-projector mapping and blending. / The mental model is: / - score produces one texture / - you have N projectors / screens, and you want each scren to show a part of that texture. / This is configured in the "Multi-window" mode of the Window device. / It supports edge blending (double-clic on the dashed line near borders) / and perspective transforms (double-click in a zone). / Use the various test cards to set-up your mapping. / Combined with rect-mapper, the other video mapping example, you can put any content you want on / any display supported. / There's no limit to the displays supported, the resolution, etc. other than your GPU power."

### P2 "Circular" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

categories: ci; inputs: inputImage:image, iZoom:float=1, iSteps:float=19, iMouse:point2D=[0,0], iColor:color=[0.9,0.6,0,1]

```glsl
// https://www.shadertoy.com/view/XslSRj
void main(void){
	float d = distance(gl_FragCoord.xy, RENDERSIZE.xy * vec2(0.5,0.5).xy);
	float x = sin(5.0+0.1*d + TIME*-4.0) * 5.0;
	x = clamp( x, 0.0, 1.0 );
	gl_FragColor = vec4(x, x, x, 1.0);
}
```
